record.title: AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0
record.original_title: 人工智能安全治理框架2.0

english_version.by: National Cybersecurity Standardization Technical Committee (TC260) and CNCERT

record.summary: Version 2.0 of China's national AI safety governance framework. Building on version 1.0 (2024), its principles include preventing loss of control and keeping AI under human control. It classifies AI safety risks as inherent technical, application and derivative risks, up to catastrophic risk, and sets technical countermeasures, comprehensive governance measures and safety guidelines for development and use. Annexes set principles for grading risks into five levels by application scenario, level of intelligence and scale, the top level having catastrophic and systemic features, and basic principles for trustworthy AI such as ultimate human control.
record.notes: Released on 15 Sept 2025 at the main forum of the 2025 National Cybersecurity Publicity Week. TC260 prepared it under CAC guidance with CNCERT, which led the drafting, and issued it as a TC260 technical document. It also calls for registering AI systems used in critical information infrastructure, for national standards on classifying and grading AI application security risks, for an AI safety evaluation system, and for developers to test regularly whether models may pose loss-of-control risks. Replaced by version 3.0 on 14 Sept 2026 (CN-17).

verification.note: Stored: the CAC release notice of 15 Sept 2025; the framework PDF linked from it (92 pages: the Chinese text, then the issuers' English text, with TC260 and CNCERT on the cover); and the CAC notice of 14 Sept 2026 releasing version 3.0. Title, original title, date, issuers, contents and the replacement by version 3.0 are confirmed from these. Summary, notes and topics were rewritten from the Chinese text in October 2026. The stored secondary copy from tc260.org.cn is the TC260 home page, not the framework's posting.

judgment.status_reasoning: Version 2.0 was formally released on 15 Sept 2025. The CAC notice of 14 Sept 2026, now stored for this record, records that TC260 released versions 1.0 and 2.0 in 2024 and 2025 and has now released version 3.0 of the same framework, prepared to respond to new trends and challenges. The register treats the new version as replacing 2.0: Superseded. The notice does not say 'replaces' in words.
judgment.scope_reasoning: National AI safety governance framework; in scope without a scope note.
